title: Double screening in the training dynamics of variational physics-informed neural networks for heterogeneous coupled parabolic systems
summary: We analyze the training dynamics of variational physics-informed neural networks applied to linear coupled parabolic convection--diffusion--reaction systems, called heterogeneous when only a subset of the components undergoes convective transport. In the neural tangent kernel regime, the gradient flow on the space-time variational residuals reduces to a linear differential system whose operator is a Gram matrix built from the space-time symbol of the system operator and the matrix tangent kernel.
